items.question: Are these tools really free?
items.answer: Yes! All tools are completely free to use with no limitations. No account required, no signup, no hidden fees.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: All processing happens locally in your browser. Your files and data are never uploaded to any server. We take your privacy seriously — zero data collection.

items.question: What tools are available?
items.answer: We offer document converters (PDF/Word/PPT/Excel to Markdown), text tools (case converter, URL encoder), developer tools (diff checker, code to PDF), and AI chat export for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and more.

items.question: Do I need to install anything?
items.answer: No installation needed for online tools — they work directly in your browser. For AI chat export, you can install our free browser extension from the Chrome Web Store.

items.question: What file formats are supported?
items.answer: Document tools support PDF, DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX. Text tools handle JSON, CSV, Markdown, HTML, and more. AI chat export supports Markdown, JSON, PDF, TXT, CSV, and PNG.

items.question: Does it work on mobile?
items.answer: Yes! All online tools work on any device with a modern browser — desktop, tablet, or phone. The browser extension is for desktop Chrome/Edge.

download.title: Download AI Chat Exporter - Install Extension Manually
download.description: Download AI Chat Exporter Chrome extension for free. Step-by-step guide to install the extension manually via Developer Mode.
download.keywords: AI Chat Exporter download, Chrome extension download, install extension manually
download.subtitle: Install the extension manually in just a few simple steps. No Chrome Web Store required.
download.fileInfo: Version 1.0.7 | ~30KB | Chrome, Edge, Brave & other Chromium browsers
download.step1Desc: Click the download button above to save the ZIP file to your computer.
download.step2Desc: Right-click the downloaded ZIP file and select "Extract All" or use your preferred extraction tool. Remember the extraction location.
download.step3Desc: Open Chrome/Edge browser, type chrome://extensions in the address bar and press Enter.
download.step4Desc: Find the "Developer mode" toggle in the top-right corner of the extensions page and turn it ON.
download.step5Desc: Click "Load unpacked" button, then select the extracted folder (the one containing manifest.json). The extension icon will appear in your browser toolbar!
download.visualToggle: Toggle this switch ON in the top-right corner
download.faq1Q: Is it safe to install extensions this way?
download.faq1A: Yes! AI Chat Exporter is open-source. All processing happens locally in your browser - your conversations never leave your device. You can verify the source code on our GitHub repository.
download.faq2A: Since this is a manual install, the extension won't auto-update. Check our website periodically for new versions, or star our GitHub repo to get notified.
download.faq3Q: Does it work on Edge or Brave?
download.faq3A: Yes! AI Chat Exporter works on any Chromium-based browser including Microsoft Edge, Brave, Opera, and Vivaldi. The installation steps are the same.
download.faq4Q: Why install manually instead of Chrome Web Store?
download.faq4A: The Chrome Web Store review process can be slow. Manual installation gives you immediate access to the latest version. The extension is identical in functionality.
download.ctaNote: 100% Free | No Account Required | Privacy First

q1.a: The tool detects dark pixels (handwriting) in the areas you paint over and replaces them with the surrounding background color, effectively erasing the handwriting.

q2.a: Yes! All image processing happens entirely in your browser. Your exam images are never uploaded to any server.

q3.a: JPG, PNG, and WEBP formats are supported. For best results, use a well-lit, high-resolution photo of your exam paper.

q4.q: Can I undo my brush strokes?
q4.a: Yes! Use the Undo button or Ctrl+Z to undo brush strokes. You can also use Redo (Ctrl+Y) to reapply them.

q5.a: No — it only removes markings in the areas you paint over. Printed text outside the painted areas remains intact.
